events.name: Technical Paper Presentation
events.description: Present your innovative research, engineering breakthroughs, or technological reviews in front of esteemed industry and academic jurors.
events.rules:
1. Standard IEEE or college format.
2. Maximum 10 minutes presentation + 3 minutes Q&A.
3. Bring PPT on a clean flash drive and carry 2 printed copies.
4. Judge decisions will be final.

events.name: Aptitude Rapid Fire Quiz
events.description: Test your quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, and rapid decision-making skills against the sharpest minds across colleges.
events.rules:
1. Individual competition.
2. Round 1: Written screening test (30 mins).
3. Round 2: Rapid-fire buzzer round on stage.
4. Negative marking applicable for Round 2.

events.name: Technical Treasure Hunt
events.description: Crack technical riddles, decode mechanical engineering blueprints, and navigate SITRC campus checkpoints to uncover the final vault.
events.rules:
1. Exactly 2 members per team.
2. Total 5 progressive clue checkpoints across the campus.
3. Clues involve technical puzzles and mechanical fundamentals.
4. Fastest team to decrypt all clues wins.

events.name: Free Fire Tournament
events.description: Deploy your squad in the ultimate Battle Royale showdown on Bermuda/Purgatory. Showcase strategy, precision, and team coordination.
events.rules:
1. Squad tournament (configurable 4 members).
2. Custom room match rules will be shared on the official WhatsApp group.
3. Emulators are strictly prohibited; mobile phones only.
4. Toxicity, hacking, or glitches will lead to immediate disqualification.

events.name: Chess
events.description: Battle of intellect and strategy on 64 squares. FIDE rapid/blitz time control format for true grandmaster spirits.
events.rules:
1. Individual classical/rapid tournament.
2. Swiss-league format followed by knockout semifinals.
3. Time control: 15 minutes + 5 seconds increment per player.
4. Touch-move rule strictly applied.

events.name: Neon Cricket
events.description: Experience box cricket in an electrified glow-in-the-dark neon arena. Fast-paced, thrilling, with special neon power plays.
events.rules:
1. 5 players per team.
2. Box cricket rules with fluorescent balls and boundary nets.
3. 4 overs per innings.
4. Highest aggregate run score advances to tournament knockout.

events.name: Poster Competition
events.description: Express engineering innovations, sustainable green technology, or industrial automation through compelling visual poster artistry.
events.rules:
1. Individual competition.
2. Standard A2/A3 chart or digital print display.
3. Topic themes: Green Energy, Smart Manufacturing, Future Robotics.
4. Originality and visual clarity carry maximum marks.

events.name: CAD War
events.description: Race against the clock to design complex 3D mechanical components and assemblies using industry CAD software (AutoCAD / SolidWorks / Creo).
events.rules:
1. Exactly 2 members per team.
2. Problem statement provided at the beginning of the lab round.
3. Modeling precision, geometric tolerances, and completion time decide rankings.
4. Workstations provided with SolidWorks/AutoCAD.

events.name: IdeaPitch (Kumbh Mela)
events.description: Pitch scalable tech solutions for crowd management, sanitation, logistics, security, and sustainability for the upcoming mega Nashik Kumbh Mela.
events.rules:
1. Teams of 2 to 4 members.
2. 7 minutes pitch presentation + 3 minutes jury defense.
3. Working prototype or feasibility architecture diagram earns bonus points.
4. Jurors will assess social impact, technical feasibility, and scalability.

site_settings.event_description: National Level Technical & Cultural Festival organized by the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Sandip Institute of Technology & Research Centre (SITRC), Nashik. In association with Mechanical Engineering Student Association (MESA) and Institution of Engineers India (IEI) Student Chapter.
site_settings.venue: Department of Mechanical Engineering, D-Building, SITRC, Nashik
site_settings.payment_instructions:
1. Scan the QR code using any UPI application.
2. Pay the exact registration amount.
3. Complete the payment.
4. Copy the UTR / Transaction ID.
5. Upload the payment screenshot.
6. Submit the registration.
